Quality Every Plungie is backed by a 10-year warranty. Learn more Still have questions? Does Plungie come with a warranty? Every Plungie comes with a 10-year warranty to give you peace of mind. Our market-leading warranty policy assures that your Plungie can be enjoyed for many years to come. Read more here. How is a Plungie installed? We are the manufacturer and supplier only — the installation is organized by you through a local builder, pool builder, or structural landscaper; depending on your location. In some locations, you can even install it yourself as an owner-builder. We can connect you with a trusted Plungie installation partner if there is one available in your area. Learn more on our Find an Installer page. Why is a precast concrete pool better than a fibreglass pool? There are many reasons why a precast concrete pool is superior to a fibreglass pool. From engineering, the required site preparations, durability, sustainability plus so much more. Read more here . What is a Plungie made from? All Plungies are precast concrete pools meaning they are a purpose built in a factory and arrive onsite ready to be installed. Read more about why not all precast pools are built the same here . What is a hydrostatic valve? Why do I need one in my pool? A hydrostatic valve helps relieve groundwater pressure on your pool shell after heavy rainfall, preventing it from popping out of the ground. Regardless of whether it’s concrete, fiberglass or vinyl-liner, every in-ground pool requires a hydrostatic valve to prevent serious damage to the pool shell and backyard. reviews.text: My wife and I had a Plungie Max pool delivered to our home outside of Charleston SC from TX. Our Plugie sits on an elevated concrete pad so that we can access from our main deck level at the rear of our home. Unfortunately, once we filled our pool with water, we noticed some rust spots at the bottom of our pool. We sent pictures of these spots directly to Plungie, and began our correspondence with Michael Sander's, who assured us that Plungie would stand by their warranty for our pool to have these stains removed and repaired, which occurred as a result of some of the metal rebar being too close to the side wall. After the repairs were made, we also unfortunately notice some "soft spots" in our pool where the Eco Finish did not adhere to the concrete pool. Again, unfortunately, guidance that we were given lead to our entire pool having the original Eco Finish removed from our pool via sandblasting. Our pool then also needed to be "repaired" in order for a new Eco finish to be applied. Michael Sanders and two of his colleagues made a very long drive from TX to our home in SC, within a day of our last phone conversation, and spent 3 days preparing for the pool to have the new Eco Finish applied by another outsourced contractor. I am now happy to say that the work has been completed on our pool, which we are now able to enjoy again. Clearly, we would have preferred that our new pool did not experience any manufacturing defects with concerns of noticeable repairs made. However, I am writing this review to note that the Plungie team did honor their warranty and went above and beyond to make sure we were more than satisfied by investing considerable time, effort and expense in resolving our issues.
reviews.author: Tim Conway

reviews.text:
I am still in the process of finishing my Plungie pool, but so far, everything has been great. Plungie worked with me to coordinate shipping dates and delivered on time flawlessly.  Product looks great too.  Complete with construction cover to protect it while my house is being built.

I got my  10x20 Plungie max pool in the ground using Luke Parsons Design Build.  Luke worked very closely with Damian at Plungie to make it seamless for me.

I’ll post another review once everything is hooked up and running!  Stay tuned.
reviews.author: Matthew Daniel

reviews.text: My overall experience (April 2023 install - Max) with Plungie has been satisfactory. I recently submitted a second warranty claim on the Eco-Finish and while there were some challenges with Plungie’s corporate scheduling function and communication, the warranty repair team led by Brian was outstanding. They were punctual, professional, and took great care in completing the work. Their skill and positive attitude reflected very well on the company.
reviews.author: Bryan Noteboom

reviews.text: I have had a Plungie Max for the last 3 years and I think I am one of the few in a northern climate(Michigan) that has one.  It has been a great pool, but we had a few outstanding issues that have been a problem from the beginning.  Our ecofinish coating had some issues from the factory and needed to be repaired via warranty work.  Michael did a great job helping us process that request and was able to get the ecofinish team out to reshoot and repair some cracks in the finish.  Their team did an amazing job and it looks as good, if not better than new!  Plungie stood behind their warranty and I am so glad I went with it.  Thanks to Michael and the team at Plungie.  I look forward to many more years of enjoying our pool.
reviews.author: Ed Wilcox

reviews.text:
Our Plungie Max was one of the first installed in central Texas in 2021.  We researched plunge pools for some time and were excited when the Plungie Max became available here in the U.S.  We love the whole concept of a plunge pool: a functional size, low maintenance and fast and easy installation.
A short time later we noticed the Eco Finish began to flake off on steps and slowly increased in size.  We submitted a warranty claim online with Plungie USA.  Michael Sanders approved an Eco Finish dealer/contractor to schedule a new application for our pool.  The contractor, Brian, was top-notch, experienced, and thorough in explaining the process of removing the old and applying the new. He helped us decide on a new color, Kona Coast. (Due to the scale in our water our original color was no longer suitable.) The upper section was left bare of the new finish so we could add tile at a later date which was not part of our original blue color order.)
The old color was hand scraped off and the interior prepped for the new color application. In the process, when the pool light was removed, it was discovered that the pool electrical line was not in a hard conduit.  The light could not be re-attached. A section of our concrete pool deck had to be removed to add a new electrical line to a new pool light. This was an unforeseen repair and expense to the repair claim, which Michael Sanders approved. He was available and very attentive to the unique obstacle we faced in the repair and once the work was completed Mr. Sanders followed up with us to make sure we were satisfied with the outcome. We are very happy Plungie customers, not only with the product itself but with the exceptional customer service Mr. Sanders provided.  (Top photo added showing new coping tile added after new finish)
reviews.author: PJ Austin

reviews.text:
Plungie support & warranty reps have been great - very easy to work with and accommodated a variety of different issues.

While naturally you don't want to have any issues at all, Plungie did make it easy to get them remediated.

Sharon & Brian were our reps and were great to work with.
reviews.author: Benjamin Carr

reviews.text: After quite a bit of research and a referral by a friend, I decided to buy a concrete pool from Plungie.  It was a great decision!!  The process of ordering the pool was incredibly easy and they connected me with a contractor that worked in my area and had experience in dealing with these types of pools.  From start to finish the process was so easy and so much faster than a traditional swimming pool install.  I had the pool within 6 weeks of placing the order.  Plungie was very responsive to my questions.  I decided to keep the pool fully aboveground because of the shallow rock that exists on my property.  From start to finish it was a great experience and I'm so excited to enjoy my Plungie pool this summer and for years to come.
reviews.author: Cydney Schwarzlose

reviews.text: I installed the Plungie Max pool and I am very pleased with the end result.  I have owned a vinyl liner pool and 2 fiberglass pools in the past.  The quality of the precast concrete and finish of the Plungie is superior.  Working with Rusty during the whole process was very straight forward, with limited issues.  I highly recommend the Plungie product.
reviews.author: dan petry

data.summary: Reviews appear authentic, detailing specific product experiences and warranty processes. A clear pattern of Eco-Finish coating issues exists, but the company's warranty response is documented. The low total review count is a minor concern, but the content is credible.
fake_signals: Low total review volume (41) for a 5-year company
No negative reviews in sample, but pattern of finish issues suggests potential review filtering
authentic_signals: Specific details about product (Plungie Max, Eco-Finish), locations (MI, TX, SC), and staff (Michael, Brian, Sharon, Rusty, Damian)
Warranty claims described in detail with mixed outcomes
Varied writing styles and project timelines
Reviews mention both satisfaction and ongoing issues
